reason: The sachet idea is handy since I forget bottles at home, but $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and I can already get magnesium cheaper. I'm not paying extra for a brand I've never heard of.
objection: It costs more than what I already know and I can't tell if the lab report is worth the extra money. Made in China makes me want a lower price, not a higher one.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $19 to $20 for the 30 days, or a cheap 7-day trial pack to try it in my gym bag first.
